story_description: Create the visual components for rendering hook execution events in a Gantt chart format, enabling users to see hook timelines with proper visual hierarchy, expandable rows, and interactive elements.
task_description: Build the GanttRow SwiftUI view that renders a single hook timeline event as a horizontal row containing the hook name label, expand/collapse chevron for children, and an embedded GanttBar showing the execution timeline with proper indentation based on nesting depth.
atom_description: Implement GanttRow.swift as a SwiftUI View that displays a single HookTimelineEvent row within the Gantt chart. The row contains a leading label area with hook name, category icon, expand/collapse chevron (if children exist), and a trailing GanttBar component positioned according to the event's start/end times relative to the visible time range. Supports indentation based on depth property and propagates selection/expansion callbacks to parent view.
problem_statement: The Hook Gantt Visualization feature requires a reusable row component that renders individual hook timeline events. Each row must display the hook name with proper indentation based on hierarchy depth, show an expand/collapse chevron when children exist, render the category-colored timeline bar at the correct horizontal position, and support hover/click interactions. Without this component, the HookGanttView cannot render the timeline list.

Hook name label with category icon (SF Symbol from HookTimelineCategory.icon)
Indentation based on depth property (leading padding multiplied by depth)
Expand/collapse chevron button when children array is non-empty
GanttBar child view embedded in trailing area showing timeline bar
Binding to selectedEventId for selection highlighting
Binding to expandedEventIds Set for tracking expansion state
onSelect callback closure for row tap handling
onToggleExpand callback closure for chevron tap handling
Support for truncated hook names with full name in hover tooltip

assumptions: HookTimelineEvent model exists with id, name, category, startTime, endTime, depth, children, status properties (from G001-MODEL)
GanttBar view exists and accepts event, timeRange, barHeight parameters (from G006-BAR)
BlazeTheme provides color constants for selection highlighting and category colors
SwiftUI Environment provides colorScheme for dark/light mode adaptation
Parent view provides timeRange as ClosedRange<Date> for bar positioning calculation
Maximum indentation depth is 4 levels (depth 0-3) to fit within 300px sidebar
DSSpacing design system tokens are available for consistent spacing
constraints: Row height must be fixed at 32pt for consistent list layout in LazyVStack
Total row width constrained to 300pt sidebar width minus 16pt padding
Label area takes 100pt fixed width; bar area takes remaining 184pt
Indentation per depth level is 16pt leading padding
Chevron button hit area must be at least 44x44pt for accessibility
Must use SwiftUI native components (no UIKit bridging)
Must support both light and dark color schemes
Row must be stateless - all state managed via bindings from parent
functional_requirements: FR1: GanttRow shall accept HookTimelineEvent, selectedEventId Binding<UUID?>, expandedEventIds Binding<Set<UUID>>, timeRange ClosedRange<Date>, onSelect closure, and onToggleExpand closure as parameters
FR2: GanttRow shall display the event name in a Text view with .body font, truncated with ellipsis if exceeding label width
FR3: GanttRow shall display the category icon (HookTimelineCategory.icon SF Symbol) leading the name with 4pt spacing
FR4: GanttRow shall indent the entire row content by (depth * 16pt) leading padding
FR5: GanttRow shall display a chevron.right SF Symbol that rotates to chevron.down when expanded, only visible when event.children is non-empty
FR6: GanttRow shall highlight with accent background color when event.id equals selectedEventId
FR7: GanttRow shall call onSelect(event.id) when row is tapped anywhere except chevron area
FR8: GanttRow shall call onToggleExpand(event.id) when chevron button is tapped
FR9: GanttRow shall embed GanttBar view in trailing area passing event, timeRange, and barHeight (24pt)
FR10: GanttRow shall apply status-based opacity: 1.0 for running/completed, 0.6 for pending, 0.4 for failed/cancelled
FR11: GanttRow shall provide accessibilityLabel combining event name, category, and status for VoiceOver
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Row rendering shall complete in under 1ms for smooth 60fps scrolling in LazyVStack
NFR2: Memory footprint per row instance shall not exceed 500 bytes
NFR3: Hover tooltip shall appear after 200ms delay and dismiss after 100ms on exit
NFR4: Selection highlight animation shall use .easeInOut(duration: 0.15) timing
NFR5: Chevron rotation animation shall use .spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.7)
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create new file GanttRow.swift in Blaze/Sources/UI/Hooks/ directory

Step 2: Define GanttRow struct with View conformance and required properties: event (HookTimelineEvent), selectedEventId (Binding<UUID?>), expandedEventIds (Binding<Set<UUID>>), timeRange (ClosedRange<Date>), onSelect ((UUID) -> Void), onToggleExpand ((UUID) -> Void)
Step 3: Implement computed property isSelected returning event.id == selectedEventId
Step 4: Implement computed property isExpanded returning expandedEventIds.contains(event.id)
Step 5: Implement computed property hasChildren returning !event.children.isEmpty
Step 6: Implement body as HStack with fixed 32pt height containing label area and bar area
Step 7: Build label area HStack: indentation spacer (depth * 16pt), chevron button (conditional), category icon Image, name Text
Step 8: Implement chevron Button with SF Symbol chevron.right rotating 90 degrees when isExpanded, wrapped in conditional @ViewBuilder for hasChildren
Step 9: Apply .rotationEffect(.degrees(isExpanded ? 90 : 0)) with spring animation to chevron image
Step 10: Add GanttBar(event: event, timeRange: timeRange, barHeight: 24) as trailing view with frame maxWidth .infinity
Step 11: Apply .contentShape(Rectangle()) for full-row tap target
Step 13: Apply selection highlight: .background(isSelected ? Color.accentColor.opacity(0.15) : Color.clear) with animation
Step 14: Apply status-based opacity modifier using switch on event.status
Step 15: Add .accessibilityElement(children: .combine) and .accessibilityLabel with descriptive text
Step 16: Add #Preview macro with mock HookTimelineEvent showing normal, selected, and expanded states
Step 17: Write unit tests for computed properties and UI snapshot tests for visual verification
data_model_changes: No new data models - GanttRow is a pure view component consuming existing HookTimelineEvent model

GanttRow.body: some View (SwiftUI View protocol requirement)
event_contracts: onSelect callback invoked with UUID when row body (non-chevron area) is tapped
onToggleExpand callback invoked with UUID when chevron button is tapped
ui_states: Default state: row displays name, icon, optional chevron, bar; no highlight
Selected state: row has accent-colored background highlight at 15% opacity
Expanded state: chevron rotated 90 degrees pointing downward
Running status: full opacity (1.0), bar may show animation (handled by GanttBar)
Pending status: reduced opacity (0.6) indicating not-yet-started
Failed status: reduced opacity (0.4) with bar showing error styling (handled by GanttBar)
Hover state: subtle brightness increase (handled by GanttBar tooltip trigger)
ui_interactions: Tap anywhere on row (except chevron) triggers onSelect callback, updates selection highlight
Tap chevron button triggers onToggleExpand callback, rotates chevron with spring animation
Hover over row for 200ms triggers tooltip display (delegated to GanttBar hover handling)
VoiceOver focus reads accessibility label describing hook name, category, status, duration
ui_copy: Chevron accessibility hint: 'Double tap to expand' or 'Double tap to collapse'
No static copy - all text derived from HookTimelineEvent properties
edge_cases: Edge case 1: event.name exceeds 100pt label width - Text truncates with ellipsis, full name available in tooltip
Edge case 2: depth value is 0 - no indentation applied, row starts at leading edge
Edge case 3: depth value exceeds 4 - indentation capped at 64pt to prevent bar area collapse
Edge case 4: children array is empty - chevron not rendered, no toggle functionality
Edge case 5: selectedEventId is nil - no row shows selection highlight
Edge case 6: event.endTime is nil (running hook) - GanttBar handles rendering animated/growing bar
Edge case 7: timeRange is zero duration (start equals end) - GanttBar handles as point-in-time marker
Edge case 8: event.status is cancelled - row shows at 0.4 opacity with cancelled indicator
Edge case 9: Very long hook names with special characters - Text handles Unicode, truncation at character boundary
failure_modes: FM1: onSelect closure is nil or not connected - row tap has no visible effect, log warning in debug builds
FM2: onToggleExpand closure is nil - chevron tap has no effect, expansion state unchanged
FM3: GanttBar view fails to render - row shows label area only, empty trailing space
FM4: timeRange binding invalid (end before start) - GanttBar may render with zero width, no crash
FM5: Memory pressure causes view redraws - LazyVStack recycles row views, state preserved via bindings
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/UI/Hooks/GanttRow.swift. Remove any ForEach usage of GanttRow in HookGanttView.swift (revert to placeholder text). No data migration required as this is a stateless view component.

risks: Risk 1: Fixed 100pt label width may be too narrow for long hook names, causing excessive truncation
Risk 2: Nested ForEach with GanttRow children may cause performance issues with deep hierarchies
Risk 3: Selection and expansion callbacks may conflict if user taps chevron area boundary
Risk 4: Spring animation on chevron may feel inconsistent with other app animations
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Provide full name in hover tooltip via GanttBar; consider adaptive label width in future iteration
Mitigation 2: Parent view uses LazyVStack and limits visible depth to 3 levels; deeper children require drill-down
Mitigation 3: Chevron button has explicit 44pt hit area separate from row tap gesture contentShape
Mitigation 4: Use consistent animation timing from design system (DSAnimation.spring) if available
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - GanttRow is a leaf view component. Failure affects only Gantt visualization display, not hook execution or data storage. Other views (chat, sidebar) unaffected.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If GanttRow has issues, temporarily replace with simple Text displaying event name. Full Gantt visualization degrades to list view while row component is fixed.
